# AGENTS.md — `codomyrmex/tests/fixtures/sair`

## Purpose
Offline SAIR test fixture: `offline_fixture.jsonl`, a small identity-equivalence
dataset (pairs of equations with TRUE/FALSE answers) for deterministic,
network-free tests of the SAIR math-distillation logic.

## Gotchas
- Keep the fixture tiny and deterministic — it is the no-network control for SAIR tests.
